description: North Carolina Secretary of State Business Search & Entity Enricher. Searches the NC SOS business registry by company/entity names and enriches entities with official-source fields such as status, SOS ID, registered agent, principal address, annual report, and phone.

properties.title: Search Terms
properties.name: searchTerms
properties.description: One or more company/entity names; each is searched against the NC SOS business registry.

properties.title: Max Results Per Search
properties.name: maxResultsPerSearch
properties.description: Maximum number of matching records to save per search term.

properties.title: Include Profiles
properties.name: includeProfiles
properties.description: Fetch the profile page of each matched entity to include principal address and registered agent fields when available.

properties.title: Include Filings
properties.name: includeFilings
properties.description: Fetch filing metadata for each matched entity. Does not download PDFs.

properties.title: Extract Phones
properties.name: includePhones
properties.description: For each matched entity, fetch the latest NC SOS annual report PDF, OCR page 1, and extract the principal place of business phone number when present on the form.

properties.title: Enable Affiliate Resolver
properties.name: enableAffiliateResolver
properties.description: When an exact legal-name search returns no results, retry with conservative brand/owner terms (e.g. 'Brennan' from 'Brennan Investment Group'); matches are flagged as possible_affiliate instead of direct_legal_name.

properties.title: Use Managed Browser
properties.name: managedBrowser
properties.description: Route NC SOS requests through a managed browser session. Recommended for cloud deployments.

properties.title: Managed Browser Headless
properties.name: managedBrowserHeadless
properties.description: Run the managed browser without showing a window. Keep enabled when running on Apify Cloud.

properties.title: Managed Browser Timeout (sec)
properties.name: managedBrowserTimeoutSeconds
properties.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the managed browser session to reach the NC SOS search page before failing.

properties.title: Request Delay (sec)
properties.name: requestDelaySeconds
properties.description: Polite delay between NC SOS requests on the fallback HTTP channel. The managed browser has its own pacing.

properties.title: Session JSON
properties.name: sessionJson
properties.description: Fallback only. JSON containing cookies, antiforgery_token, and user_agent from an initialized NC SOS session. Used only when managedBrowser=false.
